claim.value: An export still running after one hour has already crossed the duration threshold.
claim.scope: Threshold classification does not require completion once the hour has been exceeded.

provenance.rationale: P019 explicitly supplies the ongoing-export threshold classification.

signal_basis.value: Using queue-entry-to-upload-completion timing, an export remains running after more than one hour has elapsed.
signal_basis.scope: The elapsed time exceeds one hour; an export stopped before that point has an unknown threshold outcome.

provenance.rationale: P008 supplies the timing convention; P019 supplies the observed condition and the qualification for earlier stops.
No unresolved empirical relation is required for this threshold classification.

rationale: An ongoing export's elapsed duration is already greater than one hour. Completion is unnecessary to establish that it has exceeded that threshold.
uncertainty: The eventual completion time remains unknown, but that does not affect this claim.
